tagline: The logistics partner of choice for 400,000 customers worldwide
hero_kpi_rationale: The Air Logistics segment is a strategic pillar of group performance, with an exceptional conversion rate of 27 percent in Q1 2026, significantly higher than the group average of 16 percent, demonstrating operational excellence and premium positioning in a market strained by geopolitical disruptions.

kpis.name: Net turnover
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by all group operations.
kpis.description: The group generated net turnover of CHF 5.6 billion in the first quarter of 2026, driven by Air, Road, and Contract Logistics.
kpis.signal: Solid net turnover in Q1 2026 despite geopolitical disruptions.

kpis.name: Group operating income
kpis.explanation: Consolidated earnings before interest and taxes.
kpis.description: Group EBIT totaled CHF 343 million in Q1 2026, supported by efficiency measures and strong commercial momentum.
kpis.signal: High EBIT driven by cost management and strong performance of key segments.

kpis.name: Group conversion rate
kpis.explanation: EBIT divided by net turnover, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: The group's conversion rate was 16% in Q1 2026, reflecting strong operational discipline despite external challenges.
kpis.signal: Stable conversion rate reflecting rigorous operational discipline.

kpis.name: Air Logistics EBIT
kpis.explanation: Operating income of the Air Logistics segment.
kpis.description: Air Logistics contributed CHF 111 million to group EBIT in Q1 2026, with an exceptional conversion rate of 27%, benefiting from increased demand for charter solutions following Middle East tensions.
kpis.signal: Key segment with 27% conversion rate, driving profitability.

kpis.name: Sea Logistics EBIT
kpis.explanation: Operating income of the Sea Logistics segment.
kpis.description: Sea Logistics recorded EBIT of CHF 113 million in Q1 2026, with a 25% conversion rate, despite increased service intensity related to Middle East disruptions.
kpis.signal: Strong performance with 25% conversion rate despite Middle East disruptions.

kpis.name: Road Logistics EBIT
kpis.explanation: Operating income of the Road Logistics segment.
kpis.description: Road Logistics generated EBIT of CHF 25 million in Q1 2026, with market share gains across all regions and establishment of land bridges in the Middle East.
kpis.signal: Market share growth across all regions and innovative logistics solutions.

kpis.name: Contract Logistics EBIT
kpis.explanation: Operating income of the Contract Logistics segment.
kpis.description: Contract Logistics generated EBIT of CHF 94 million in Q1 2026, including CHF 35 million from the sale of a real estate property in Germany, with opening of new distribution centers.
kpis.signal: Performance strengthened by an exceptional CHF 35 million gain on real estate sale in Germany.

kpis.name: Total headcount
kpis.description: The group employs more than 85,000 people across more than 1,300 sites in close to 100 countries, constituting one of the world's largest logistics networks.
kpis.signal: Extensive global network with more than 85,000 employees across nearly 100 countries.

kpis.name: Sea Logistics volumes
kpis.explanation: Ocean freight volumes measured in twenty-foot equivalent units (TEU).
kpis.description: As of end March 2026, Sea Logistics volumes totaled one million TEU, with increased service intensity related to regional disruptions.
kpis.signal: Volumes of one million TEU as of end March 2026, impacted by Middle East disruptions.

kpis.name: Air Logistics volumes
kpis.explanation: Air freight volumes measured in tonnes.
kpis.description: As of end March 2026, air freight volumes totaled 516,000 tonnes, showing slight positive growth compared to the prior year in a constrained capacity environment.
kpis.signal: Volumes in slight growth despite a tight market with 516,000 tonnes as of end March 2026.

kpis.name: Sea Logistics net turnover
kpis.explanation: Net revenue of the Sea Logistics segment.
kpis.description: The Sea Logistics segment generated net turnover of CHF 1.9 billion in the first quarter of 2026.
kpis.signal: Net turnover of CHF 1.9 billion in Q1 2026 for Sea Logistics.

kpis.name: Air Logistics net turnover
kpis.explanation: Net revenue of the Air Logistics segment.
kpis.description: The Air Logistics segment generated net turnover of CHF 1.6 billion in the first quarter of 2026.
kpis.signal: Net turnover of CHF 1.6 billion in Q1 2026 for Air Logistics.

kpis.name: Road Logistics net turnover
kpis.explanation: Net revenue of the Road Logistics segment.
kpis.description: The Road Logistics segment generated net turnover of CHF 908 million in the first quarter of 2026.
kpis.signal: Net turnover of CHF 908 million in Q1 2026 for Road Logistics.

kpis.name: Contract Logistics net turnover
kpis.explanation: Net revenue of the Contract Logistics segment.
kpis.description: The Contract Logistics segment generated net turnover of CHF 1.2 billion in the first quarter of 2026.
kpis.signal: Net turnover of CHF 1.2 billion in Q1 2026 for Contract Logistics.

kpis.name: Group net earnings
kpis.explanation: Consolidated net profit of the group.
kpis.description: The group generated net earnings of CHF 248 million in the first quarter of 2026.
kpis.signal: Net earnings of CHF 248 million in Q1 2026, reflecting strong operational performance.
